verses.gurmukhi: ਫਰਕਤ ਲੋਚਨ ਅਧਰ ਭੁਜਾ ਤਾਪੈ ਤਨ  ਮਨ ਮੈ ਅਉਸੇਰ ਕਬ ਲਾਲ ਗ੍ਰਿਹ ਆਵਹੀ ॥
verses.translit_en: farakat lochan adhar bhujaa taapai tan  man mai aauser kab laal gireh aavahee ||

en.bdb: With earnest desire of meeting my beloved Lord in my heart, my eyes, lips and arms are quivering. My body temperature is rising while my mind is restless. When will my dear beloved come to abide into my house-like heart?

verses.gurmukhi: ਨੈਨਨ ਸੈ ਨੈਨ ਅਰ ਬੈਨਨ ਸੇ ਬੈਨ ਮਿਲੈ  ਰੈਨ ਸਮੈ ਚੈਨ ਕੋ ਸਿਹਜਾਸਨ ਬੁਲਾਵਹੀ ॥
verses.translit_en: nainan sai nain ar bainan se bain milai  rain samai chain ko sihajaasan bulaavahee ||

en.bdb: When will I have my eyes and words (lips) meeting with the eyes and words (lips) of my Lord? And when will my beloved Lord call me to His bed at night to make me enjoy the divine pleasure of this meeting?

verses.gurmukhi: ਕਰ ਗਹਿ ਕਰ ਉਰ ਉਰ ਸੇ ਲਗਾਇ ਪੁਨਿ ਅੰਕ ਅੰਕਮਾਲ ਕਰਿ ਸਹਿਜ ਸਮਾਵਹੀ ॥
verses.translit_en: kar geh kar ur ur se lagai pun a(n)k a(n)kamaal kar sahij samaavahee ||

en.bdb: When will He hold me by my hand, take me into His embrace, in His lap, around His neck and plunge me into the spiritual ecstasy?

verses.gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਰਸ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਪੀਆਇ ਤ੍ਰਿਪਤਾਇ ਆਲੀ  ਦਇਆ ਕੈ ਦਇਆਲ ਦੇਵ ਕਾਮਨਾ ਪੁਜਾਵਹੀ ॥੬੬੫॥
verses.translit_en: prem ras a(n)mirat peeaai tirapatai aalee  dhiaa kai dhiaal dhev kaamanaa pujaavahee ||665||

en.bdb: O my co-congregational friends! When will the beloved Lord make me drink the loving elixir of spiritual union and satiate me; and when will the effulgent and kind Lord become benevolent and appease the desire of my mind?  (665)
